In ضرط (marginal note beside the line "ob summam ejus audaciam"; the Arabic word is doubtful, the marker reads "In" with the Arabic word after it). Al Midani, & Ahmed Ebn Yusef. (note beside the line "Arabum*"; "Midani" is set with a hyphen at the line end, read as printed.)

Arabic words in this transcription are copied as far as they can be read from the scan. Several lines of Arabic are uncertain, particularly the first line of the top paragraph, the word after "scil." and the words after "Abu Kabus"; they are not marked with [?] inside the Arabic itself, so check them against the original.
